attribution: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) House Price Index, all-transactions, not seasonally adjusted: metropolitan area and state indices (quarterly) and the experimental five-digit ZIP code index (annual). US federal government work, public domain. ZIP codes are placed in metros with the US Census Bureau 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship file and the July 2023 OMB core based statistical area delineations. Districts: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI), Zillow Research (zillow.com/research/data).
basis: FHFA House Price Index: all-transactions repeat-sales index (sales and appraisals on Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac mortgages), NSA

name: Austin
notes: Austin: the city series is the FHFA all-transactions index for Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX (FHFA area code 12420), quarterly from 1989 Q1; the full history from the first published quarter is the long-history chart. Districts are Zillow's monthly home values (ZHVI: all homes, middle tier, smoothed, seasonally adjusted; a modelled value, not transaction prices) for 84 ZIP codes and 185 neighborhoods in the metro, shown as quarterly medians; Zillow's metro and the principal city are comparison rows. Zillow terms restrict reuse; credited, removable. Index levels are not comparable across areas: each series is rebased to 100 in the base period.
